what: Stacked photos swap every 4 seconds — the next one covers the previous in 1.2s with a slanted surface (clip-path) rising from the bottom-left corner, and the covered one drops behind after 2.4s. First swap after 3.3s

options.fx:slide: Event sent to the element on every swipe (detail.index) — ties together side motions like a slot reel

from.where: index.js [data-slides] (Hero rounded photo slider — 4 seconds, spins a small reel on each turn)
